## One uninterrupted canvas

Use this layout when one diagram, result, or line of reasoning deserves the full page. The panel protects readable padding while allowing its contents to expand vertically.

- Replace this prose with Markdown, equations, figures, tables, or callouts.
- Keep the hierarchy shallow: one message, one visual centre of gravity.
- Remove the panel class when the content itself should touch the canvas edges.
